reviews.title: Great value and an easy way to protect your desk!
reviews.body: I recently bought an "affordable" desk for my computer setup.  The desk surface consists of particle board with a printed laminate on top.  This kind of surface is know for getting scratches and water rings.  This mat has lots of space, easily protecting the wood top from normal use.  The mat's surface is leather-like with a fine, satin finish texture giving it a fine leather look.  It comes rolled but flattens out quickly. The quality is very good and I expect to get several years of use before I'll need to replace it.  I recommend getting a mat that bigger than you might think you need because you'll find out you really can use the space!Read moreRead less

reviews.title: This is a well made writing mat / desk protector is a solid value and a pleasure to use.
reviews.body: Hi.  I purchased the dark blue version of this writing mat/desk protector and I am quite pleased with its usefulness and how it looks. I purchased the smallest version and, as you can see in the photos I’ve attached, it’s proven to be a practical size for my desktop workspace.The mat has a texturized, cloth like, underside that effectively prevents it from sliding on the smooth desktop as I type or use the mouse.  And, speaking of the mouse … I am able to use my Apple mouse on it without any problems at all.  There is ample space to the right of my keyboard for me to use the mouse without any changes or compromises for space.  It’s a layout that works well and I’m happy to say good-bye to my separate, stand alone, mousepad.The mat I received arrived rolled up in a rectangular box (see attached photos) and had a significant curl on its release.  The good news is that this is easy to fix.  I lay the mat, face down, on my desk and then placed a single layer of hardcover books on top of it, entirely covering its surface.  I left it this way overnight and in the morning the curl had almost disappeared.  For good measure, I repeated this process the next night and, the following morning the mat was perfectly flat and ready for use.The takeaway:  This writing mat / desk protector is a good looking and useful addition to a home office workspace.  It eliminates the need for a separate mousepad and provides a welcome “pop” of  color that is a simple visual pleasure on its own.Read moreRead less
